doc.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Small talk about Hamilton and goodbyes
summary: Chat about Cortland apples and the fall leaves, then thanks and goodbyes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Yeah, it’s just an hour and a half south of us.
Yeah, it’s a nice area, as you can see in our picture here.
Oh, yeah. In fact it will be for a few weeks, right? The leaves and all?
Probably until, the same season as Vermont-New Hampshire.
Well thanks for sharing your time. It’s been a great pleasure.
So on behalf of Hamilton College, I’d like to thank Dave McKenna and we’ll be listening tonight.
